description: Turn on/off full computation mode. In full computation mode, moments are balanced by calculating equivalent forces. When turned off, barycentric interpolation is used to calculate the gridpoint forces and translational stiffnesses.
notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
3D only live: both 2D consoles answer 'The reduced strategy is not applicable to 2D' (2D always uses full computation).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): accepted on PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8; rejected with the reduced-strategy error on both 2D consoles.
